sheets.title: West/East Wall - North (Hoistway 3D Scan Survey)
sheets.reading_notes: 3D laser scan survey of north hoistway wall showing as-built vs. plumb line deviations. Floor levels shown: Pit (93'-11-11/16"), Level 1 (100'-0-3/8"), Level 2 (115'-0-3/16"), Level 3 (125'-11-13/16"), Level 4 (137'-0-1/16"), Level 5 (148'-4-1/16"), Level 6 (157'-9-9/16"), Roof (172'-10-1/16"). North wall width between levels approximately 19'-0". Deviations from plumb measured in fractions of an inch; generally small (<5/8") except at Level 5 where deviation reads 0'-0-17/32". Project number NNSY_B276, drawn 2022-01-12 by TKM. Scale 1/4"=1'-0".

sheets.title: East/West Wall - South (Hoistway 3D Scan Survey)
sheets.reading_notes: 3D laser scan survey of south hoistway wall. Similar floor level arrangement to A101. Width approximately 19'-0" between levels. Deviations generally small (0"-9/16"). Plumb line vs. as-built overlay shown. Scale 1/4"=1'-0".

sheets.title: North Wall - East and South Wall - East (Hoistway 3D Scan Survey)
sheets.reading_notes: 3D laser scan survey showing two walls: East wall north side and East wall south side. Nominal hoistway dimension in the east-west direction approximately 12'-1" to 12'-3-1/2". Notable deviation at Level 6 on north side: 0'-3-5/16" from plumb (larger than typical — flagged as potentially significant for elevator guide rail alignment). Deviations on south side generally smaller (<1"). Scale 1/4"=1'-0".

sheets.title: South Wall - West and North Wall - West (Hoistway 3D Scan Survey)
sheets.reading_notes: 3D laser scan survey of west wall faces. Nominal dimension approximately 12'-1" to 12'-3". Some deviations at upper levels (Level 6: up to 0'-2-21/32" on south-west face). General pattern: hoistway walls are reasonably plumb at lower levels but have greater deviation at upper levels near roof. This is consistent with the structural BOD narrative about the 1942 concrete construction.

floor_count.quote: Elevator 49 has a total of four stops.
floor_count.notes: Building has 4 occupied floors served by elevators plus rooftop machine room. Scan drawings show 6 'levels' but Level 5 and Level 6 appear to be penthouse/machine room levels above the 4th floor. Floor count confirmed as 4 (1st through 4th).

hoistway_dimensions.notes: Dimensions read from 3D scan survey drawings. These are as-built hoistway dimensions (with minor plumb deviations noted).

hvac: One ductless split air conditioning system (outdoor + wall/ceiling fan coil unit) in machine room — new per Elevator 49 BOD
Existing exhaust fans and louvers — one relocated, thermostat controlled and interlocked with intake louvers
BAS/DDC integration required per SAES: HVAC system connects to NNSY base-wide DDC system
electrical: New 3P/200A breaker in existing Switchboard CL (480Y/277V) for Elevator #49
New 100A, 208Y/120V, 3-phase, 4-wire panelboard in machine room for Elevator #49
Fused elevator control switch with integral shunt trip relay — both elevators
LED lighting throughout: machine room, hoistway, cab
GFCI duplex receptacles in machine room, pit, top of hoistway
Elevator #50 existing 3P/200A breaker in Switchboard CL to be reused for new #50 feeder
Emergency communications: two-way intercom, master station in machine room, lobby station at 1st floor
plumbing: Submersible sump pump in elevator pit — schedule 40 steel discharge piping to building exterior
Sump pump with oil minder system
fire_protection: Existing wet pipe sprinkler system modified for elevator shaft/machine room coordination
New sprinkler piping to machine room from 4th floor with supervised shut-off valve, check valve, waterflow switch, and test valve
Shunt trip breaker actuation from waterflow switch
Smoke detection at all elevator landings and machine room
Fire alarm system modified to interface with elevator controllers for Firefighters' Emergency Operation (FEO)
